_about: Contracts: posted work. rank: the guild rank (F, E, D, C, B, A, S) needed before it is posted (default F). issuer: the character (by name) who posts it; only posted while someone of that name with standing (holdings) is about. objectives: deed patterns (kind + tags, empty = any) x count; reward: character experience (stats) and gold, paid when turned in at the guild desk. Three are open at a time on the stats page's CONTRACTS tab; a finished one is replaced by the next in turn.

contracts.name: Woodcutter's Errand
contracts.about: The forge needs fuel: fell three trees.
